verdict.rationale: The evidence pack contains no documentation of a public API. The cited docs cover filing procedures for trademarks, patents, designs and e-Soleau, plus a database search page, all presented as human-facing web flows. The probe only shows data.inpi.fr returning HTTP 403 to a keyless GET. Its note about account-issued tokens hints at gated data access, but no API reference, endpoints or developer documentation is evidenced.
